title: TNM expands Malawi data infrastructure
why: Domestic telco TNM buys OCL's Tier 3 data centre in Kanengo and offers Data Centre as a Service (owner, centre).

title: Sparc moves to end Malawi's reliance on offshore data
why: Malawian firm Sparc Systems launches a Lilongwe data centre offering local hosting (owner, centre).

title: Ministry showcases DMAP Milestones at ICTAM 2025 AGM
why: Government systems being migrated to the National Data Centre (state).

title: Invitation to Early Market Engagement - Expansion of the National Data Centre
why: State Tier 3 data centre in Lilongwe hosts critical government systems and data (centre, state).

title: Lilongwe data centre ready May
why: Tier 3 Lilongwe government data centre to host all public information systems (centre, state).

title: Terms of Reference for Provision of Managed Services for the National Data Centre
why: Both Lilongwe and Blantyre national sites are Tier-III; 13 racks for co-location (centre, state).

title: Environmental and Social Management Plan, National Data Centre, DMAP
why: National Data Centre offers DCaaS, rent/lease to MDAs, co-location racks (centre, state).

title: The Malawi National Data Center - Blantyre
why: Blantyre centre built with ESCOM (state enterprise), Tier 3, offers colocation to private sector (centre, owner).
